extraction_warnings: Paper reports n=15 Yanomami/Brazil samples and includes comparative data from previously published cohorts (Yanomami/Venezuela n=8, Matses n=24, Tunapuco n=12, US n=44), but individual sample identifiers and per-sample metadata (age, sex per individual) are not provided in accessible text. Supplementary Table 1 referenced as containing details but not provided in the supplied paper text.

Sex and age information were collected (stated: 'age and gender information of individuals were also acquired') but neither sample-level values nor study-level summary statistics are reported in the body text.

The study is observational/comparative (traditional vs. urban groups) but does not explicitly designate samples as 'Case' or 'Study Control' per the schema. Recommend classifying Yanomami/Brazil as index group and US group as external comparison.

Sample-level extraction limited by lack of per-participant identifiers and metadata in the main paper. Only one aggregate-level microbiome study is represented in the samples array due to absence of individual IDs and stratified reporting.
